method: Ray intersections through final exported assembly STLs; actual G-code radial track clusters at clip midplanes. No force/fatigue simulation.

0.physical_test: Press each upper key while mounted and inspect the complete key-to-clip path for whitening, layer splits or excess bending.

key_floor_note: The central rod-clearance cut reduces the floor locally to 1.2 mm; away from the rod it is 1.38 mm. Do not report 1.38 mm as the minimum.

fixed_reinforcement.note: These are source dimensions with exported one-body/interface checks, not breaking-force predictions. Sliding wedge dimensions and spring profiles remain unchanged.

Key_Carrier.load_case: Switch insertion loads the rim; fixed outboard rails bypass its thin section for the key-to-clip pressing load.
Key_Carrier.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis; XZ is the layer plane.
Key_Carrier.decision: Preserve the bought switch opening and scan the complete reinforced load path separately; the rim still needs a real insertion trial.
Key_Carrier.required_physical_test: Insert the actual switch, press normally and inspect whitening or layer separation on every tested seat.

Key_Carrier.load_case: Socket insertion, removal and pressing load a locally thin floor.
Key_Carrier.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis; XZ is the layer plane.
Key_Carrier.decision: Keep the socket and rod clearance. Direct backing and a real socket trial are required.
Key_Carrier.required_physical_test: Remove helpers without levering the floor; insert and remove a real socket and press the key.

Key_Carrier.load_case: Upper-key pressing and insertion transfer through the front-to-rear connection, across layer lines in this orientation.
Key_Carrier.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis; XZ is the layer plane.
Key_Carrier.decision: Add outboard fixed rails while preserving mounting lands and complete switch/socket routes; scan every intervening layer as well as these probes.
Key_Carrier.required_physical_test: Try the repaired coupon first, then repeatedly press both upper keys while mounted; stop on whitening, separation or excess bending.

Key_Carrier.feature: Four fixed joints between key rows
Key_Carrier.load_case: Upper-key pressing bends the connectors and can peel layers across Y.
Key_Carrier.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis; XZ is the layer plane.
Key_Carrier.decision: Locally thicken the fixed joint from 1.2 to 2 mm without moving the seats; full-height trial required.
Key_Carrier.required_physical_test: Support the carrier as mounted and repeatedly press both upper keys; inspect the four joint roots.

Key_Carrier.load_case: Socket insertion and key pressing load the rear columns.
Key_Carrier.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis; XZ is the layer plane.
Key_Carrier.decision: Retain the 1.9 mm rounded fixed columns; trim an obsolete 0.27 mm detached leading strip that the slicer omitted.
Key_Carrier.required_physical_test: Inspect the rear columns after cleanup and under repeated key pressing; bought-part routes must remain clear.

Key_Carrier.load_case: Socket insertion and sideways handling load a narrow stop between the floor and mounting lip.
Key_Carrier.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis; XZ is the layer plane.
Key_Carrier.decision: Retain the 1.35 mm bought-interface stop. Its 4.47 mm clear printed bridge must be tested in the key coupon.
Key_Carrier.required_physical_test: Inspect the stop bridge and push the seated socket gently sideways; stop on cracking, whitening or looseness.

Battery_Holder.load_case: Battery retention and accidental snags bend the cage hoops.
Battery_Holder.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis; XZ is the layer plane.
Battery_Holder.decision: Grow crossbars from 1.4 to 2 mm and connect longitudinal stringers; sag and retention remain unverified.
Battery_Holder.required_physical_test: Inspect all hoop/stringer joints and bridge sag, then gently load the real cell without pouch pressure.

Battery_Holder.load_case: Cell weight and sliding insertion load the floor.
Battery_Holder.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis; XZ is the layer plane.
Battery_Holder.decision: Reinforce outside the battery reserve; the full cell-loading route remains clear.
Battery_Holder.required_physical_test: Slide the real cell in and out and inspect floor joints for cracking or whitening.

Battery_Holder.load_case: Gate wedging can split thin outside walls across their printed layers.
Battery_Holder.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis; XZ is the layer plane.
Battery_Holder.decision: Grow the outside wall from 0.8 to 1.6 mm and add an outside diagonal; preserve the slot.
Battery_Holder.required_physical_test: Try the real gate gently; stop if it binds or whitens either guide. Never force it against the cell.

Battery_Holder.load_case: Guide bending transfers through a diagonal into the roof post.
Battery_Holder.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis; XZ is the layer plane.
Battery_Holder.decision: Add a 1.6 mm outside brace without entering the gate route; check the actual root and diagonal print.
Battery_Holder.required_physical_test: Inspect both diagonals for gaps or layer splits before trying the gate.

Battery_Holder.load_case: Roof bars transmit retention loads through the longitudinal centre support.
Battery_Holder.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis; XZ is the layer plane.
Battery_Holder.decision: Join successive crossbars with a 2 mm stringer, reducing the unsupported crossbar span.
Battery_Holder.required_physical_test: Inspect every crossbar/stringer junction and the free end after helper removal.

Battery_End_Gate.load_case: Gate insertion and removal flex its narrow sliding wedges.
Battery_End_Gate.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis; XZ is the layer plane.
Battery_End_Gate.decision: Preserve the wedge fit, print its broad face on the bed and use the reinforced centre as the handle.
Battery_End_Gate.required_physical_test: Cycle the gate without a cell first; inspect narrow ends and verify removal by the central bar.

Battery_End_Gate.load_case: Pulling at the centre distributes removal load instead of using a wedge as a handle.
Battery_End_Gate.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis; XZ is the layer plane.
Battery_End_Gate.decision: Increase the print depth from 1.6 to 2.7 mm outside the cell and sliding paths.
Battery_End_Gate.required_physical_test: Pull at the central bar, checking that both wedges release together without bowing or cracks.

XIAO_Rod_Holder.load_case: PCB insertion and USB lead snags load the rails and their roots.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis; XZ is the layer plane.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.decision: Grow the fixed rails outward from 1.2 to 2 mm and fixed roots from 1.6 to 2.1 mm; keep bearing faces.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.required_physical_test: Check the actual populated PCB underside and insert without forcing; gently check lead strain.

XIAO_Rod_Holder.load_case: PCB and USB loads pass through the intersecting diagonals into the clip crown.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis; XZ is the layer plane.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.decision: Thicken fixed ribs to 2.1 mm nominal diameter; intersecting roots are wider than the individual rib.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.required_physical_test: Inspect root bonding and check the complete holder under gentle board/lead handling.

XIAO_Rod_Holder.load_case: Rod sliding and lateral handling bend the thin rails between the clips.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.layer_direction: Assembly Y is the layer axis; XZ is the layer plane.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.decision: Thicken the fixed middle rail from 1.25 to 2 mm, stopping before the free clip arms; retain the bore and spring profile.
XIAO_Rod_Holder.required_physical_test: Print the full-height sensor holder and slide onto the rod from its end; inspect rails and clip roots.

qualification: Geometric and extrusion-section screening only. Physical trial is required for every listed load case; no guaranteed breaking force or fatigue life.
